children.name: Extra Hit Points
children.local_notes: Includes HP formerly bundled with ST.

children.name: Injury Tolerance (Diffuse)

modifiers.name: Diffuse
modifiers.local_notes: Immune to crippling injuries. Brain, Vitals and Groin cannot be targeted. Most foes cannot slam or grapple you (GM's decision). Do not bleed. Unaffected by blood-borne toxins. Immune to attacks that rely on cutting off blood to part of your body. Impaling and piercing attacks of any size never do more than 1 HP of injury, regardless of penetrating damage. Other attacks never do more than 2 HP of injury. Exception: Area-effect, cone, and explosion attacks cause normal injury

modifiers.name: Homogenous
modifiers.local_notes: Altered wound modifiers: imp & pi++ are x1/2, pi+ is x1/3, pi is x1/5, pi- is x1/10

modifiers.name: No Blood
modifiers.local_notes: Do not bleed, unaffected by blood-borne toxins, immune to attacks that rely on cutting off blood to part of your body

modifiers.name: No Brain
modifiers.local_notes: Brain cannot be targeted. Blows to the skull or eye are treated like blows to the face, except that eye injury can still cripple the eye

modifiers.name: No Eyes
modifiers.local_notes: Eyes may not be targeted. Immune to blinding attacks

modifiers.name: No Head
modifiers.local_notes: Skull, Brain and Face cannot be targeted

modifiers.name: No Neck
modifiers.local_notes: Neck may not be targeted and cannot be decapitated, choked or strangled

modifiers.name: No Vitals
modifiers.local_notes: Attacks to the Vitals or Groin are treated as attacks to the Torso

modifiers.name: Unliving
modifiers.local_notes: Altered wound modifiers: imp & pi++ are x1, pi+ is x1/2, pi is x1/3, pi- is x1/5

children.local_notes: Hundreds of insect-sized microdrones: Injury Tolerance (Diffuse - weapons do max 1-2 damage per attack); can disperse, flow through gaps, crawl/hop/fly at Move 4. As a unit it cannot grab, lift, or wield; individual bugs can interface with electronics. Effectively No Manipulators for physical tasks.

children.name: No Manipulators
children.local_notes: As a unified swarm; individual bugs can interface with electronics.

children.name: Morph Price Adjustment
children.local_notes: Sets this morph to its chargen price: 25 EP CP / 4 = 7 points. Package value 277, adjustment -270. The package total says what the body is; the chargen price is all you pay for it, and only at creation (Part III).

local_notes: Distributed swarm synthmorph (EP 1e, 25 CP / 7 pts). No single body: HP 10 represents attrition of the swarm. Nearly unkillable by gunfire, nearly useless in a fistfight.
